title: Topic 17: Weather & Seasons - Listening
description: One audio (2 speakers) + 5 exercises including dictation.

listeningBlock.audioScript:
Lala: Hi, Ivo! Where are you?
Ivo:  At my sister's house in Recife! It is very hot
here - the sun is out, and we are swimming all
day!
Lala: Swimming?! Ivo, here in Curitiba it is COLD.
It is raining now, and the wind... terrible!
Ivo:  Ha! Winter in Curitiba, Lala. It rains every
winter there.
Lala: Yes... so I am at home. I am drinking tea and
watching films!

listeningQuestions.question: What do Lala and Ivo talk about?
options: The weather in their two cities
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: The weather in their two cities

listeningQuestions.question: What is the weather like in Recife?
What is Ivo doing in Recife?
Why is Lala at home with tea and films?
options: Because it is cold and raining in Curitiba
Because she doesn't like the sun
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: Because it is cold and raining in Curitiba

listeningQuestions.question: Type what you hear.
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: It is cold and it is raining
